description: Read one list verification: the document version it checked, the list facts it checked against as they stood then, how each of those facts stands on the list now (held or included; its tier: `document` when a source is a document's record, `testimony` when its sources are only witness accounts, `unsourced` without a source; see lists.source-documents.update), and every claim found in the document with its verdict (state, and a 0-100 support score for supported, tension and contradicted), its qualifiers (caveats that never change the verdict: the record is not expected to speak to the point, a cited fact has a different scope, no document's record backs it and it rests on testimony, every fact it rests on is unsourced, or it rests on a held fact), the facts it rests on, for a record conflict the fact suggested to govern it (the document's record over a witness's account; null when neither), and the claim's current review (null while nobody has acted on it). `carryOver` says what the run took from the previous run of the same document and list. Notes and fact links follow a claim with the same words or with edited words in the same paragraph or page; other decisions follow only the same words with an unchanged verdict. It counts the reviewed claims that came across whole and lists the rest (`text-changed`, `verdict-changed`, `unmatched`, `ambiguous`); null when there was nothing to carry.
